search_log: Listed every filing for Biogen (CIK 875045) via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. older 'files' pages; selected 8-K/8-K/A with item 2.02 filed 2015-06 onward, then checked for a release in every filing quarter: the third-quarter 2019 release (8-K 2019-10-22, accession 0000875045-19-000038) carries item 9.01 only and was added by hand. Exhibits resolved from each filing's index.json (names matching ex99/pressrelease); 2025-2026 item-2.02 8-Ks without an exhibit are pre-announcements. The 2022-07-20 8-K/A repeats the 8-K's exhibit; the original 8-K is cited.

Each quarter is read from that quarter's own release, from the one-decimal product revenues table headed 'For the Three Months Ended <quarter end>' (United States | Rest of World | Total); the header date was asserted against the quarter for every row. Integer summary tables ('$' cells) earlier in the same releases were skipped.
Rows matched: label 'FLIXABI' (with or without ™/®) on its own line in every release 2016Q3-2026Q2; series contiguous, no gaps.

Full-year check against the 'For the Twelve Months Ended December 31' table of each Q4 release (Total column): 2017: 0.6+1.9+2.2+4.3 = 9 vs printed full year 9 (ok); 2018: 6.6+11.2+11.4+14.1 = 43.3 vs printed full year 43.2 (ok); 2019: 14.7+16.8+18.4+18.2 = 68.1 vs printed full year 68.1 (ok); 2020: 23.7+20.6+27.5+26.1 = 97.9 vs printed full year 97.9 (ok); 2021: 25.5+25.3+24.6+24 = 99.4 vs printed full year 99.4 (ok); 2022: 22.5+20.5+19+19.3 = 81.3 vs printed full year 81.3 (ok); 2023: 20.4+20.1+20.2+16.7 = 77.4 vs printed full year 77.4 (ok); 2024: 17.8+13.1+16.2+16.1 = 63.2 vs printed full year 63.2 (ok); 2025: 13.1+14.3+15.3+9.9 = 52.6 vs printed full year 52.6 (ok)
